name: GhostLink Mental Model
summary: Compressed mental model of the GhostLink system: components, relationships, key files, endpoints, glossary, and next steps for further exploration.

DesignClarityOS.role: Root protocol layer that orchestrates hardware-aware agent assignment, consciousness-driven optimization, evolution scheduling, communication bridging, and process error correction.

MirrorComprehension.role: Provides system self-awareness and reflective snapshots used by the root protocol and evolution engine.

MultiAgentEngine.role: Agent generation, compression/expansion, model optimization and providing agent types to assign to hardware and applications.

EvolutionaryIntelligence.role: Performs system evolution cycles: receives system context and returns improvements to apply.

ZeroDepBackend.role: A zero-dependency HTTP backend providing content-addressed storage, cmfl cycle, routing, and a former 'wraithgate' gateway (recently renamed to 'secure_gateway').

glossary.Wraithgate: (legacy) Consent/bridge/gateway concept — translator + zero-trust choke point used in lore and docs; often maps to gateway/secure-gateway implementations.
glossary.Sentinel: (legacy) Watchdog / watchdog pattern for runs and anti-drift monitoring.
glossary.Lumara: (legacy) Persona or memory/stable knowledge base entity.
glossary.MirrorComprehension: System self-awareness and reflection layer used for unified consciousness snapshots.
glossary.Consciousness: UnifiedConsciousnessFramework — the system-level awareness module used to guide optimizations and evolution triggers.

relationships.DesignClarityOS -> MirrorComprehension: Uses self-awareness snapshots to guide optimization and evolution triggers
relationships.DesignClarityOS -> MultiAgentEngine: Obtains agent types and status to assign agents to hardware/apps
relationships.DesignClarityOS -> EvolutionaryIntellige: Feeds system context into evolutionary engine and applies returned improvements
relationships.SystemCommunicationBridge -> external sy: Manages bridges and routes messages between endpoints and protocols

notes.crawl_status: Initial crawl completed for core repo files in ghostlink-wiki-organized and Organized/Projects. A backup of ghostlinklabs docs was created before edits.
notes.gaps: Protocol-specific bridge handlers and some EvolutionScheduleManager implementation details are placeholders. Many docs contain legacy lexicon; these are preserved in the backup directory.
suggested_next_steps: Deep-parse READMEs and large content files to build a provenance index (file -> term hits -> context snippets).
Auto-generate a dependency graph (module imports -> edges) to visualize component interactions.
Extract operation traces (logs) to map runtime behavior to the model (e.g., backend.log entries).
Optionally tag legacy terms with 'legacy' and map them to neutral technical counterparts for clarity.
